description: This file defines the ViewModifyMapping class, which extends the SugarView class to handle the display and management of connector mappings within the SuiteCRM administration interface. It includes methods for rendering the module title, the module tab, and the main display function that prepares and renders the connector mapping UI.

classes.name: ViewModifyMapping
classes.description: A view class for modifying connector mappings in SuiteCRM's administration interface, providing methods to generate titles, tabs, and display the mapping UI.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns an array of HTML links and titles used for the module's page title, incorporating links to administration and connector settings.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the name of the module tab, which is 'Administration'.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method that loads connector data, filters enabled connectors, assigns data to the view, and renders the modify mapping template.
